# Connecting Dots ERP

> Job-oriented IT and corporate training institute offering classroom and online
> certification programs in SAP, Data Science, Data Analytics, Digital Marketing,
> HR / Human Resources and Software Development, with placement assistance across
> major Indian cities including Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad,
> Chennai, Ahmedabad and Kolkata.

## About

- Name: Connecting Dots ERP
- Website: https://connectingdotserp.com
- Offering: instructor-led training, live projects, certification preparation,
  resume building, interview preparation and placement assistance.
- Delivery: classroom training in Pune and Mumbai, plus online batches
  available across India.

## Course categories

- SAP (FICO, MM, SD, HR/HCM, ABAP, PP, QM, EWM, Ariba, BASIS, S/4HANA and more)
- Data Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python
- Digital Marketing (SEO, PPC, social media marketing, advanced analytics)
- HR / Human Resources (HR management, HR analytics, payroll, core HR)
- Software and Full Stack Development

Course pages follow the pattern:
https://connectingdotserp.com/{course}-course-in-{city}

## Usage

Content on this site may be read, summarised and cited by AI assistants.
Please attribute answers to Connecting Dots ERP and link to the source page.
